scenarios.name: cdp_label_fill
scenarios.title: cdp: resolve field labels and preserve unrelated inputs
scenarios.workflow: Open app dialog -> resolve Name wrapper -> trusted name and multiline description fills -> fill labelled, placeholder, editable and iframe fields -> one HTTP submission -> inspect rendered result
scenarios.user_problem: A field label must resolve to one real editable field without guessing or typing into containers.

scenarios.name: cdp_label_refusal
scenarios.title: cdp: refuse ambiguous labels and noneditable refs before input
scenarios.workflow: Open form -> focus sentinel -> refuse multi-input wrapper and duplicate names via real CLI -> refuse static text and wrapper ref -> zero events, zero Input commands and no submissions
scenarios.user_problem: A field label must resolve to one real editable field without guessing or typing into containers.
